description: Rename a site's free link to <name>.dropthehassle.app. Changing a public URL is the human owner's decision: propose the name first, and only call this with confirm=true after they explicitly said yes. With an account, pass site (its address). Without an account, pass claim_url (the claim link from deploy_site) or site_token for that unclaimed site. Safe: the old link keeps redirecting to the new name. No money. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

claim_url.description: Without an account: the claim link deploy_site returned (the part after # is the secret).

confirm.description: true ONLY after the human owner explicitly approved this exact name.

name.description: The label only, e.g. "myproject" for myproject.dropthehassle.app.

site.description: With an account: the address of the site to rename (from list_sites).

site_token.description: Without an account: that site's token, from the deploy reply. A site token sent as Bearer works too.

name: choose_link
